Noah Levy increased its stake in Pg&E Corp (PCG) by 4300% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Newtyn Management Llc bought 2.15 million shares as the company’s stock rose 8.77% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Noah Levy held 2.20M shares of the power generation company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $96.65M, up from 50,000 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Newtyn Management Llc who had been investing in Pg&E Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $22.19B market cap company. The stock increased 1.58% or $0.67 during the last trading session, reaching $42.96. About 1.56 million shares traded.
